notes: OpenHands Agent Canvas (React Router SPA) as a static production build in the repo's MSW mock mode. Rebuild: .ui-capture/build.sh (runs the seed generator, then `VITE_UI_CAPTURE_SEED=true VITE_SESSION_API_KEY=... npm run build:mock`, and copies build/ to .ui-capture/out). Tooling: node 24.22.1 + npm 11.12.1 pinned in mise.toml. Persona: Jonas Lindqvist (jlindqvist, Tidewater Labs). Data: 61 conversations over ~5 months across 6 local workspaces (harbor-api, harbor-web, route-optimizer, infra, pg-migrate-lint, dotfiles) with tags for repo/branch/workspace/project. Mixed states: finished, idle, running (2), waiting for confirmation (Terraform apply), paused, error (2), archived sandboxes (4), plus one untitled. 415 transcript events: user/agent messages, terminal commands with output, file views/edits/creates; 5 hand-written detailed transcripts (e.g. 'Fix N+1 queries on /v2/shipments list endpoint', 'Rotate RDS credentials…', 'Migrate harbor-web dashboard tables…'), the rest generated. Also 4 LLM profiles (sonnet-4.5 active), 7 secrets, 16 GitHub repos with branches, git identity, and the repo's existing automation mock data (7 automations with runs). Seeded browser state: onboarding completed and sidebar checklist dismissed (localStorage, only if unset). Timestamps shift to the viewer's clock on load. In-memory mock state resets on reload. Main areas: home launcher (/), conversation view (/conversations/:id, chat + files/terminal/browser panels), sidebar history grouped by workspace, Automations (/automations), Customize/Skills/Plugins/MCP (/customize, /skills, /plugins, /mcp), Settings (/settings/llm, /settings/agents, /settings/secrets, /settings/app, ...). Seeded browser state also records telemetry consent as answered (denied). Verification: .ui-capture/verify/static-server.mjs mimics a plain static server (index.html fallback, 405 for non-GET) and .ui-capture/verify/crawl.mjs visits 27 routes and reports any response >= 400, failed request, page error, or /api response that fell back to HTML.
